name: netzmensch-obsidian-recall-last-command
description: Obsidian plugin for recalling the last command. This is handy for quickly repeating the last command you executed, especially if it was a command that doesn't have a keyboard shortcut.

scripts.build: npm run clean && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build-debug: npm run clean && node esbuild.config.mjs development
